subject: [PATCH 1/3] mm/page_alloc: drop unused gfp_mask from zone_watermark_fast()

reviews.author: SJ Park
reviews.summary: The patch looks clean and the removal of unused code is a good thing. The reviewer gave it a positive review.
reviews.raw_body:
On Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:52:34 -0800 Joshua Hahn <joshua.hahnjy@gmail.com> wrote:

> zone_watermark_fast() has not used its gfp_mask argument since commit
> 2973d8229b78 ("mm: discard __GFP_ATOMIC") switched the watermark boost
> check from __GFP_ATOMIC to ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE.
> 
> Remove the argument, no functional changes intended.

Looks clean to me.

> 
> Signed-off-by: Joshua Hahn <joshua.hahnjy@gmail.com>

Reviewed-by: SJ Park <sj@kernel.org>


Thanks,
SJ

[...]

2026-11-13.patch_summary: This patch series removes the unused `gfp_mask` argument from several functions in the page allocation code, including `zone_watermark_fast()`. The argument was removed because it has not been used since a commit that switched the watermark boost check to use `ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE` instead of `__GFP_ATOMIC`. The patch is intended to be functional equivalent with no changes.
